verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is local inference software you run yourself. It offers source builds, pre-built binaries, Docker images and a `llama serve` server with a built-in web UI. Community users confirm running it on their own hardware, one calling it 'very nice for something self-hosted.' Missing for 10: the pack has only links and short snippets of the Docker and build guides, not the detailed self-hosted server deployment and configuration instructions themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
Run with Docker - see our [Docker documentation](docs/docker.md)
Build from source by cloning this repository - check out [our build guide](docs/build.md)
